name: chicago-buoys
description: A lightweight, source-backed buoy observation bot for Bluesky and future social publishers.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/src/cli.js --sourcemap=external --sources-content=false --legal-comments=external --minify-syntax --minify-whitespace --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
